Disha Salian Case: CBI Investigation Continues Amidst Sushant Singh Rajput Link

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is continuing its investigation into the death of Disha Salian, the former celebrity manager. The case gained significant public attention due to its proximity in time to the death of actor Sushant Singh Rajput, who died six days after Salian. Reports indicate that the CBI is examining the connection between the two cases. Details of the investigation and the specific findings remain under wraps as the probe progresses.
